summary: Known issues in dellemc.openmanage for Ansible 10.6.0, the same as 10.7.0: idrac_diagnostics can't export via SOCKS proxy, idrac_firmware can't use authenticated shares on iDRAC8, and ome_smart_fabric_uplink overwrites same-named uplinks.
questions: Were the iDRAC8 firmware share limitations present in Ansible 10.6.0?
Is the duplicate uplink name issue known in 10.6.0?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage known issues (10.6.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `idrac_diagnostics`: no export to HTTP/HTTPS shares through a SOCKS proxy.
- `idrac_firmware`: no updates from authenticated HTTP/HTTPS/FTP shares on iDRAC8.
- `ome_smart_fabric_uplink`: creating an uplink with an existing name modifies the existing one.
